overview.title: Product Overview
paragraphs: The NAV-519-VA is a robust dual-band Wi-Fi 6 outdoor access point fully managed from the cloud and built using OpenWiFi technology.
It supports a maximum combined data speed of 3000 Mbps (600 Mbps on 2.4GHz and 2400 Mbps on 5GHz) using concurrent radios.
Designed for harsh outdoor environments, it features an IP-67 rated metal enclosure and external omnidirectional antennas.
The device is zero-touch plug-and-play and automatically downloads configuration from the cloud to become operational within minutes.

features: Optimized for HD video streaming and voice calls
External omnidirectional antennas for extended coverage

hardwareSystem.processor: Qualcomm 1GHz Quad-Core CPU with dedicated NSS

advancedCapabilities.title: Weather-Resistant Design
advancedCapabilities.description: IP-67 rated enclosure withstands rain, dust, and extreme temperatures for reliable outdoor operation.

advancedCapabilities.title: Enterprise Security
advancedCapabilities.description: Advanced security features including WPA3, RADIUS authentication, and network segmentation.

advancedCapabilities.title: High-Density Support
advancedCapabilities.description: MU-MIMO and advanced RF optimization support high user density in crowded outdoor environments.

products.conclusion: A dual-band, IP-67 weather-proof Wi-Fi 6 outdoor access point delivering 3 Gbps speeds with cloud management, zero-touch deployment, and enterprise-grade security for reliable wide-area outdoor connectivity.
products.summary: A rugged, cloud-managed Wi-Fi 6 outdoor access point delivering ultra-fast speeds, enterprise-grade security, and reliable connectivity in harsh environments. Perfect for outdoor venues, industrial sites, and transportation hubs requiring high-performance wireless coverage.

overview.title: Product Overview
paragraphs: The NAV-319-VA is a modern Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) access point designed for high-performance business environments.
It features dual-band radios with cloud and controller-based management, making it ideal for centralized indoor deployments.
The device delivers a maximum combined throughput of 3Gbps across 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, ensuring reliable performance for voice and HD video applications.
Built using OpenWiFi technology, the NAV-319-VA is managed through Indio's cloud platform, enabling simple provisioning, configuration, and remote monitoring.

features: Remote management via HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, Telnet, SSL
VLAN isolation and guest access modes
Ceiling, wall, or desktop mount support
Configuration backup and restore via TFTP / FTP / HTML
Rich system information with logs and event tracking
IPv4 and IPv6 dual stack support

advancedCapabilities.title: Cloud-Native Management
advancedCapabilities.description: Built using OpenWiFi technology and managed through Indio's cloud platform for simple provisioning, configuration, and remote monitoring with zero-touch deployment.

advancedCapabilities.title: Self-Healing Mesh Network
advancedCapabilities.description: Advanced mesh networking capabilities with self-configuring and self-healing features to ensure continuous coverage and automatic network optimization.

advancedCapabilities.title: Enterprise-Grade Performance
advancedCapabilities.description: Qualcomm 1GHz quad-core CPU with dedicated NSS delivers consistent high-performance for demanding business applications and high-density user environments.

advancedCapabilities.title: Comprehensive Security Suite
advancedCapabilities.description: Advanced security features including WPA3, VLAN isolation, captive portal authentication, and deep packet inspection for enterprise-level network protection.
